description: This is a Python script implementing a WebRTC-based AI bot that uses speech-to-text, language model, and text-to-speech services, and can describe images upon client connection.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object for managing language model interactions and messages.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and execution settings.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and control flow of the pipeline.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the AI bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot.
